manifest.name: elvorance-enterprise
manifest.description: Elvorance Enterprise consolidated development source: dynamic configuration, KPI drilldowns, revised quote finances, visit readiness, microservices.

scripts.build: npm run build:apps && npm run build:services
scripts.verify: npm run check:types && npm run check:boundaries && npm run build && npm test && npm run test:parity && npm run test:regression
scripts.infra:up: docker compose --env-file infra/compose/.env -f infra/compose/compose.yaml build && docker compose --env-file infra/compose/.env -f infra/compose/compose.yaml up --no-build -d --wait --wait-timeout 180

scripts.dev: npm run build && python -m http.server 8080 --directory dist

runtimeModes.repServer: dedicated server entry, foreground tracking, no offline write synchronization
